text.text_excerpt: Queenies is legit my new favorite daiquiri spot. It doesn't hurt that it's right around the corner from the crib either. Each time I've been here has been consistently good. The owner has really taken his time to create delicious craft daiquiris. I've sampled every flavor and by far the best has got to be the St Claude Slammer which reminds me of cherry kool aid. Taste buds may differ, but everyone that I've brought has agreed. Depending on your taste buds, I would definitely get a shot added cause drinking them as is never seems to cut it. Regardless, I love me some queenies! Have yet to try the food, but good to know they have a kitchen open late!

I enjoyed this place a lot. Maybe even too much!! There are natural daiquiris. I know you are probably thinking how in the world is a daiquiri natural? Well Easy? The place use natural ingredients in their daiquiri making process. There is a mint julep daiquir that is really tasty!! You can also taste how fresh the mint is as well as all the other ingredients used in the process. It also makes the alcohol used in the daiquiri taste more better! I had the St Claude Smasher I think and it was solo good. It tasted like koolaid fruit infused Rum on a bed of ice. It was just really really refreshing!! There is also a Grill/ Food located in here as well. I will definitely be back!

Queenie's is the best! Their daiquiris aren't too sweet and the flavors are all nice and distinctive. I've tried them all and my favorites are Mango, Piety Pineapple and Mardi Melon in that order! The daiquiris taste like real fruit! The daiquiris are served in nice big containers and there are daily specials that make your visit fun. They change out their flavors every couple weeks, but there aren't as many different options as some other daquiri shops. That doesn't matter though because their flavors are superior!
